stress_value.basis: Existing stress-return threshold and reproducible stressed sizing.

model_pick.basis: Nominal model EV > 1e-9, stress threshold not passed; positive model estimate is not established edge.
model_pick.minimum_odds: (1 - push_probability) / win_probability; executable quote strictly above this break-even.
model_pick.sizing: Nominal-probability sizing with related-event discount and optional bankroll fractional Kelly. Active all_tiers_weighted_v3 and legacy model_weighted_v2 permit USD1–5 subject to configured max_bet and available/bankroll bounds. Historical unit_cap_v1 capped at USD1. An amount below USD1 is unfunded. Original issued stakes are immutable; current read-only targets are separate.

probability_pick.basis: Explicit win-probability preference with nonpositive model return, never a positive-value claim.
probability_pick.sizing: Active all_tiers_weighted_v3: configured non-Kelly base unit / sqrt(1 + related contracts), with documented affordable minimum ticket floor and USD5/configured/available/optional bankroll-fraction bounds. No positive edge or Kelly claim. Historical unit_cap_v1/model_weighted_v2 use fixed USD1 with no exposure discount.
